changes: platform_profile driver: when /sys/firmware/acpi/platform_profile is missing (a device tree boot, as on Apple silicon Macs), drive the first /sys/class/platform-profile device instead (the same patch as alarm-aurora).
notes: Built emulated, not cross: Debian's Build-Depends name python3 and python3-gi without :native, so a cross build root cannot install them next to dh-python. The patch applies with line offsets only; its integration test runs in the emulated build.
